description.value: Continental Coffee is a six-generation family coffee roasting business with roots going back to Italy; its Vancouver story began in 1979 when founder Anita Allan opened the flagship on Commercial Drive. This Main Street location opened in 2012 in the Riley Park neighbourhood and operates as a full café alongside the company's roasting plant in Burnaby. Cyclists riding the Main Street corridor will find a well-established, community-rooted shop serving house-roasted beans.
